name: tapoo-oracle
description: Tapoo's analytics extension: an Observable Framework app that profiles agent-api behavior logs against the Tapoo Agentic Behavior Rubric.

scripts.build: trap 'rimraf staged' EXIT; node ./scripts/build.mjs && ORACLE_STRIPPED_BUILD=1 observable build && node ./scripts/build.mjs --finish
scripts.deploy: trap 'rimraf staged' EXIT; node ./scripts/build.mjs && ORACLE_STRIPPED_BUILD=1 observable deploy && node ./scripts/build.mjs --finish
scripts.quality: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run test
